DCNR MAP LAYER vs BOOKING PAGE (ruling 5, reported not asked): the DCNR Designated Campsites layer (record last edited 2022-12-20) says 'TrailerAccess: No' for site 013; the booking page sells it with 'Looking For Category: RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site' and 'Max Vehicle Length: 25'. Kept; both statements are in the note.

Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): 'Site Grade: Slight', 'Driveway Grade: Slight', gravel; 'Site Height/Overhead Clearance: 15'. No caution line. The page also carries the district-wide 'Road and Travel Alert' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' boilerplate (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).
Distance to the other Tuscarora entry in this batch (017): 8.9 km; separate entries already.
Water: nothing in NHD within 200 m. Not waterfront, no lead.

Tuscarora advisories page (read 2026-11-10): district office construction (mid-July to early November 2025), a chronic wasting disease notice, firewood. No road closure, gate, bridge limit or timber-sale notice. The Tuscarora camping page publishes no seasonal closure or site rotation; it says only 'State forest roads do not receive winter maintenance and are not plowed --motorized, roadside camping access is not guaranteed. Travel at your own risk.' It names one equestrian area, Showaker; this site is not in it.
